notes.content:

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Gameplay Fixes
*Refined combat system
*Refined cooldown system, now has restrictions
*Improved skill animations
*Refined skills for all styles
*Enemy attacks, including health and damage parameters, have been changed

Important Update Fixes
*Especially in menus
*Fixed mouse not detecting
*Menu not loading
*Submenus now focus with the joystick
*Shop now works properly
